articleTitle: A novel violent video detection method based on improved C3D and transfer learning
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In recent years, due to the widespread use of surveillance systems, the crime rates significantly decreased and public security is guaranteed. However, instead of stopping ongoing crimes, these surveillance videos is often to provide clues and evidence after crimes occur. Manual monitoring is time-consuming and laborious, so it is necessary to automatically detect these violent behaviors in videos. In this paper, we propose a new violent video detection method, which improves C3D so that it can detect violent videos more effectively. In addition, we sample the input video during training, extracting one frame every two frames. In the test, the input video is not sampled. We also pre-train part of the network on the Sports-1M dataset using transfer learning method. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the method proposed in this paper reaches 99.5% on Hockey Fights, 98.37% on Violent Crowds, and 100% on Action Movie, which is very simple and effective.

articleTitle: Deep-neural Automated Essay Scoring: A Review
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Automated essay scoring (AES) is the task of automatically assigning scores to essays as an alternative to manual scoring. Traditional AES models typically rely on handcrafted features, whereas deep neural networks (DNNs) -based AES models use automatic feature selection from the original texts. Furthermore, DNNs -AES models have recently achieved fantastic results and attracted increased attention. To our knowledge, various DNNs-AES models have been designed over the past few years, but no study has reviewed DNNs -AES models from the development process of NLP techniques. Therefore, this paper classifies DNNs-AES models into two categories and introduces existing representative DNN-AES models according to this classification. The main idea and detailed architecture of each model are described.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Virtual Character based on Facial Motion Capture
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The metaverse is one of the hottest concepts right now. With the development of computer technology, digital virtual human gradually developed from concept to practical application. At present, virtual characters have gradually been launched on major video platforms. This paper introduces a virtual character implementation scheme based on facial motion capture technology. This article contains the entire process from 3D modeling, to model animation rigging, and facial motion capture, and finally applying the captured facial motion to model animation. In this paper, the Unity3d engine mainly implements the rendering of models and animations, while facial motion capture uses deep learning-based algorithms. Through the design and implementation of the entire system, it provides a set of solutions for AI engineers.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Object Detection in High-Resolution Image Based on Improved YOLO v5
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) detection is important to limit illegal UAV activity. The object detection method based on computer vision has the advantages of low cost and strong discrimination. Due to the small size of UAV, existing object detection methods are still insufficient in the detection performance of UAV. In this paper, we make targeted improvements based on the powerful YOLO v5 to improve the detection performance of small objects. First, we take the divide and conquer approach, the high-resolution image is cut into multiple image blocks to be detected separately, and the pure sky region without object is removed through the sky region recognition algorithm. In terms of network structure, to utilize the spatial information in the shallow layers, the neck and detection head of YOLO v5 are shifted to the shallower layer of the backbone. Meanwhile, Image Pyramid Guidance Network is also introduced into the network structure of YOLO v5. Experiments show that the proposed approach achieved Recall of 0.881 and mAP0.5 of 0.83 for small UAVs in our data set, significant improvement compared to before improvement.

articleTitle: The architecture and advantages of electronic warfare under the influence of artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Given the increasingly complex electronic warfare battlefield environment in the future, the artificial intelligence technology widely used in the military field is combined with electronic warfare to promote the transformation of traditional electronic warfare to intelligence. Firstly, the concept and main functions of the intelligent electronic warfare system are analyzed, and the development status of foreign countries is introduced. Secondly, the three-in-one technical system, distributed operating system, and intelligent architecture function system of intelligent electronic warfare are given. Finally, its advantages in electronic countermeasures reconnaissance, jamming, and protection are analyzed, which provides ideas for the study of electronic warfare in the context of intelligent warfare.

articleTitle: Learn from Teachers: A Teacher Learner Yoga Pose Classification and Scoring Network
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Nowadays, computer vision is more and more widely applied in fitness and healthcare. However, little research has been done on yoga in this area, even though Yoga is a very popular sport. To fill this gap, this paper proposes a teacher-learner convolutional network, namely TL-CNN model, to realize yoga pose classification and scoring. The TL-CNN model is a convolutional neural network designed based on the Siamese network. It consists of two neural networks with shared weights, namely Teacher-CNN and Leaner-CNN. Input an image pair, by calculating the cosine similarity of two embedded vector output of the Teacher-CNN and the Learner-CNN, the similarity score can be obtained. At the same time, the yoga pose classification result of the image inputting in Learner-CNN can be also obtained. In this paper, four classic yoga pose categories are selected as datasets. Satisfactory test results have been achieved in both Yoga pose scoring and classification tasks. More specifically, the classification accuracy rate reaches 1, the similarity score of the same class of pose pairs is greater than 0.99, and the similarity score of different class pose pairs is less than -0.2.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Simulation TestBed for Intelligent Unmanned Swarm System
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Aiming to meet the needs of unmanned swarm testing and verification in intelligent unmanned systems as well as solve the high-risk issues faced in physical testing, this paper designs and implements a simulation testbed. The main research includes: building a testbed architecture for a scaled-up unmanned swarm system; designing a Docker-based unmanned swarm support platform; and building a ROS-based unmanned swarm drive engine. In order to verify the feasibility of the platform, we perform a fixed-wing UAV swarm relay communication test and a semi-physical semi-simulation unmanned vehicle queue test in this paper. The test results show that the simulation testbed implemented in this paper can effectively evaluate the cooperative operation of multiple unmanned devices, and the test datas are accurate and reliable, which is of certain significance to the unmanned swarm test and evaluation.

articleTitle: Practical research on classroom teaching evaluation based on face recognition
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: This paper takes Python language as the development tool, carries out practical research on classroom teaching evaluation based on OpenCV library and Dlib deep learning library, uses face recognition technology to reform and innovate the traditional classroom teaching evaluation, obtains the class rate, rise rate and attendance rate in real time, and reduces the work pressure and burden of classroom teachers and teaching managers, It improves the efficiency and level of classroom teaching management.

articleTitle: The Design of Code Coverage Tools for Embedded Integrated Development Environment
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In the past few years, with the rise of internet of things, more and more attention is paid to Internet of Things technology, and it has been widely applied in smart home, intelligent transportation, intelligent industry, intelligent medical and any other fields. The development of IoT depends on the embedded software, and its testing is also one of the focuses of attention of the developer. Most of embedded applications is built by C-language, and the code coverage can be regard as an important indicator. The existing code coverage tools often can’t meet our actual needs. In this case, I develop a code coverage tool, which integrate statement coverage, branch coverage, and function coverage. As long as all the test cause pass, it shows the reliability and usability. The code coverage analysis tools will be integrated in the embedded integrated development environment based on Eclipse as plug-in finally.

articleTitle: A learning resource recommendation system based on knowledge graph and community elites
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In order to efficiently achieve accurate recommendation of learning resources, a collaborative filtering algorithm based on knowledge graph and community elites is established. We propose a big data-based service recommendation system to help learners select the content that best meets user needs from massive learning resources. The new system combines resource attribute information (knowledge graph) and user attribute information (community elite) to propose a rough multi-dimensional matrix model based on collaborative filtering algorithm. By constructing a simulated recommendation system, the method proposed in this paper is verified and compared, and finally it is proved that the method proposed in this paper is superior to the comparison method in performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Cartoonization Algorithm without Deep Learning
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In this paper, we propose an algorithm to transforming photos of real-world scenes into cartoon style images, which is valuable and challenging in computer vision and computer graphics. Our solution belongs to traditional image processing-based methods, which have recently ignored to stylize images in artistic forms such as painting while deep learning has become popular. However, learning methods produce cartoonization by consuming time, quantity data and energy. Due to the fact that cartoon styles have similar characteristics with simplification and abstraction, and cartoon images tend to have clear edges, smooth color shading and relatively simple textures, which is quite make a mountain out of a molehill for learning-based algorithm used in existing methods. In this paper, we propose a novel image cartoonization algorithm without deep learning. Our method does not need prepare dataset and training, which is easy to use. Our method is also producing satisfied vision results. Experimental results show that our method is able to generate high-quality cartoon images from real-world photos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm Based on Supervising LLE Fabric Detection
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In this paper, an improved algorithm based on Gabor filter cluster is proposed to supervise LLE fabric detection. This algorithm is used to do simulation experiments for the flaw of fabrics, and the experiment results show that the proposed method can effectively highlight the defect of the fabric, improve the detection accuracy, and optimize the detection time.

articleTitle: Analysis of key technologies in the hydrogen energy industry based on big data research
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: As a clean, efficient, safe and sustainable new energy source, hydrogen has the advantages of wide source, high combustion calorific value, renewable and zero carbon emission. This paper investigates and analysis the current hydrogen energy industry from the supply side and application side based on big data research and the current development trend of hydrogen energy.

articleTitle: Computer intelligent proofreading method for English translation based on phrase translation model
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: English translation computer can only correct the difficulties that can be applied to machines and improve the accuracy of machine translation. The English translation computer intelligent correction method proposed in this paper can realize automatic intelligent proofreading of English translation by developing correct vocabulary that can replace the vocabulary to be proofread. This paper further designs a simple system based on the computer intelligent proofreading method of English translation. Through the final test analysis, it can be concluded that the English translation computer intelligent proofreading system can effectively improve the accuracy of English translation.

articleTitle: The Prospect of Interpretation Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the vigorous development of AI technology, AI big data analysis is also widely used in the field of interpretation, and the number of empirical research is increasing year by year. The prospect of interpretation based on artificial intelligence big data analysis has gradually become a research hotspot. With the development of computer linguistics and artificial intelligence technology in the field of foreign languages, the research methods and technical means of artificial intelligence big data analysis have also been introduced into the research and practice of interpretation. With the development of communication technology and artificial intelligence, translation work, including interpretation, is increasingly combined with advanced scientific and technological products, which is worth thinking and research. Based on the analysis of AI big data and from the perspective of interpretation theory, in this paper, theoretical support for the interpretation work is sought under the framework of AI big data analysis, the problems encountered in the work are solved, and a prospect and prediction of the development trend of interpretation work is made.

articleTitle: Research on crop disease identification based on GoogleNet
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Crop diseases and pests seriously affect the growth and production of crops. Timely and accurate identification and control can effectively improve the yield and quality of crops. A total of 15 types of data in the data set of Plant Village, including healthy pepper and plaque leaves, healthy potato early blight and late blight, and common tomato diseases, were selected for classification and recognition by using deep learning algorithm. The correct rate of crop disease identification based on GoogleNet is 96.86% in the case of small samples. This study has obvious advantages in small sample size and processing efficiency, it can meet the agricultural needs of rice pest classification and detection in the field, and has great application potential in the field of agricultural informatization in the future. It is suitable for field interactive collection and processing combined with mobile devices.

articleTitle: Drone Swarm "Agile Suppression" Tactics
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm, as a new quality power growth point of electronic warfare, has been widely paid attention to all over the world. This article will open innovative uav swarm combined with operational concept of "agile suppression", from the principle of methods, the implementation method, grasp the key points, four aspects such as the core, for example, elaborated the uav swarm "agile suppression methods and value, the advantages of uav swarm fighting for the future research laid the theoretical basis of related, as our system of battlefield electromagnetic power advantage added.

articleTitle: Mining of rectal cancer data based on decision tree algorithm and logistic regression algorithm
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Colorectal cancer can occur at any age, but most patients are over the age of 40. Colorectal cancer is also one of the most preventable tumors. It usually arises from "polyps" that are noncancerous new growths of the colon or rectal epithelium. If it is screened, detected early and removed, it can prevent it from becoming a tumor. The medical community believes that bowel cancer is the most curable cancer if detected early. The purpose of this study was to use decision tree and Logistic regression algorithm to establish early colorectal cancer based on various non-invasive factors such as basic information, dietary habits, recent main symptoms, family history of disease, past history of disease, and serological examination in patients with colorectal cancer. A cancer risk prediction model, while analyzing the factors that have an important impact on early colorectal cancer risk prediction, in order to assist clinical screening of early colorectal cancer risk before invasive colorectal cancer endoscopy and pathological biopsy, which can further promote the improvement of early colorectal cancer risk Colorectal cancer detection rate.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-Latency and High-Throughput Parallel Sorter for Sphere Detector
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The MIMO-OFDM systems request high-throughput and low-latency sphere detector. In this paper, a parallel sorter with high-throughput and low-latency is presented for sphere detector, and it can arrange two ascending-sorted lists of numbers into one ascending-sorted list. The comparators of parallel sorter work in parallel and generate the results through the selection of unique route. Meanwhile the parallel sorter has a short critical path, and it can achieve high work frequency. The parallel sorter array can support the sort of more sequences through simply concatenation of parallel sorter. A parallel sorter array which can sort eight groups of eight dimension has been implemented by SMIC 0. 13 um CMOS process, and the max throughput is 360Mbps at work frequency of 360MHz, and the delay is three clocks.

articleTitle: Research on the System Design and Verification of Health Promotion Algorithm Based on Self-feedback of Integral Mechanism
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In recent years, the public has become more and more concerned about health, but there is no better mechanism to supervise and feedback people's exercise effect. Based on this, this paper mainly focuses on urging people to exercise continuously and improve their self-quality through a system based on the integral and self-feedback mechanism. The core algorithm of the whole system is mainly divided into two parts. The first is the single integral formed by the exerciser's weighted calculation from dimensions including physical fitness, exercise type, exercise time, and exercise heart rate. The second is to make statistics from the continuity of exercisers' movements to form the total exercise points. If the continuity is good, the total points will increase. If the continuity is poor, the total points will decrease. The body data of the exercisers during exercise is collected through the Bluetooth bracelet, processed on the smartphone, and verified by algorithmically generating exercise points. Through the follow-up survey of exercisers, it is found that the change of total points is positively correlated with the change of the exerciser's physical state, which shows that the self-feedback of integral mechanism has a good effect in promoting people to exercise and maintain physical health.

articleTitle: A New Machine Learning Algorithm for Users’ Movie Recommendation
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In this information era, even a movie lover may feel overwhelmed when facing numerous movies on the movie website. Therefore, an efficient movie recommendation system is needed. In this paper, two different recommendation systems were compared, based on the user-based collaborative filtering and the content-based collaborative filtering respectively. Basically, several relevant studies were referred to, and a huge dataset was used from MovieLens. After pre-processing the data, where the data was transformed into matrixes of each user’s rating and the corresponding movie (the rating matrix represented the eigenvector of each user), cosine similarity was used to obtain the similarity relationship between users by calculating the cosine similarity between those eigenvectors. Then, K-NearestNeighbor (KNN) algorithm was used to select a certain number of users having the highest similarity with the target, based on which predicted how the target would rate a movie and recommended the movie with the highest predicted score to the target. In the part of using the content-based collaborative filtering, films in each category were ranked based on the average and the number of the scores and the user’s favorite movie types were obtained by the user-movie genre preference matrix based on the scores that users gave to each type of movies. The movies with the highest score in each target user’s favorite movie type would be recommended to the target. Experimental outcomes indicate that both algorithms generally meet the needs of users despite of the differences in the results.

articleTitle: Fault analysis of power battery based on voltage data record of realworld fired electric vehicles
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: At present, the number of new energy vehicles (NEVs) in other countries is far lower than that in the Chinese market, and there are few cases of fire accidents aboard. Therefore, there is a lack of in-depth and systematic research on NEV accident investigation technology and defect determination technology aboard. At home, based on the accident reporting system of the State Administration of Market Regulation (SAMR), the Defective Product Administrative Center (DPAC) has mastered the most abundant fire accident data of NEVs in China, which lays the foundation for the safety research of NEVs. Based on a real accident case, this paper carries out the research of NEV fault traceability judgment based on power battery voltage, which has important guiding significance for NEV accident investigation.

articleTitle: Classification for Intracranial Hemorrhage Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Intracranial hemorrhage has become a social health problem that cannot be ignored, which leads to huge strokes worldwide and serious sequelae. As the first choice to diagnose the Intracranial hemorrhage, attention to subtle details on CT images and speed of diagnosis are key points in medical diagnosis. In this paper, a hemorrhage detection model based on convolutional neural network (CNN) was established to realize high accuracy classification based on specific CT images dataset which were classified into two categories with label hemorrhage and no hemorrhage. The original model had 3 convolutional layers and 2 fully-connected layer. To improve the CNN model, several controlled experiments were conducted to figure out the influence on the testing accuracy with different number of convolutional layers, different number of neurons in fully-connected layers and different number of fully-connected layers. The experiments are carried out in the order mentioned above, and the basic model of the subsequent optimization experiments is built on the best performing model in the previous experiments. To verify the performance of self-designed CNN model, MobileNetV2 and VGG16 were selected and trained on the same dataset. The results indicated that self-designed CNN model had better performance than that of MobileNetV2 and VGG16 on collected dataset.

articleTitle: Multi-label topic classification for COVID-19 literature annotation: A BioBERT-based feature enhancement approach
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the rapid expansion and exponential growth of biomedical literatures, especially in the current environment of COVID-19 pandemic, it is urgent to explore an effective technology to automatically manage and categorize massive information for biomedical texts. The wide application and powerful performance of BERT have shown promising results in the field of natural language processing. Thus, we first choose the improved pre-trained language models CovidBERT and BioBERT as the basis, from the best performance of which further enhances semantic representation of abstract with extra title information. Finally, a novel feature enhancement method is proposed to exploit and integrate the distribution of label information effectively. The experimental results show that our model achieves an instance-based F1 score, precision and recall of 93.94%, 93.5% and 94.38% in the task of multi-label topic classification from track 5 BioCreative VII.

articleTitle: Discussion of the traffic flow prediction model based on the GSP algorithm
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In order to meet the fast travel in the time-changing environment, the driver needs to analyze and predict the vehicle driving path on the road, and plan the favorable routes. This paper optimizes the traditional GSP algorithm to optimize the adjacent nodes and combine the traffic flow history data. The model effectively reduces the number of candidate sequences required to be scanned, overcoming the limitations of the basic sequence model.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Method of Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the continuous innovation of Internet technology, the explosive growth of information has become one of its most obvious characteristics, and how to break through the problem of data storage has become an urgent challenge to be solved. The knowledge graph proposed by Google can intuitively describe the relationship between entities in the objective world in the form of a graph, which is of great help in solving this problem. Firstly, the basic concept of knowledge graph is expounded, and include the key steps of knowledge extraction, knowledge fusion, knowledge storage, etc. Taking the relationship between confirmed cases of the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) in a certain city over the recent period as an example, a knowledge graph of case relationship is constructed. The results indicated that the knowledge graph intuitively shows the transmission path of the epidemic, which can provide certain help for the effective prevention and control of the epidemic.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Analysis Technology in Classification Statistics of Ancient Tomb Murals
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: This paper is committed to display the statistical analysis results of ancient fresco classification data briefly by big data analysis and data visualization technology, which combined Java, Spring framework, BootStrap development template and other Web development technologies. This paper realizes visualization and interactive function of the visual chart through the data visualization module of the Web page. At the same time, users can search and view the data analysis results by themselves, so as to introduce the knowledge of tomb murals and relevant important news. This project is proposed through the digital protection and all-round in-depth study of tomb murals. It uses big data analysis technology to sort out and summarize the attributes of ancient tomb murals, and classified statistics with the theme as the core, so as to reshape users' information cognition of ancient tomb murals. In this way, the relationship between data and information can be quickly obtained from multiple dimensions, the knowledge system of tomb murals can be established, and the indepth study of tomb murals can be further promoted.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of network teaching resources in Colleges and Universities Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: This paper constructs a construction scheme of internal network teaching resources in colleges and universities, and tests the relationship between users' search and missing attributes through the incomplete data analysis method of rough set theory, and fills in the information system of mixed teaching resources. A set-theoretic approach to imputation of missing values in a network teaching resource system in mixed-information colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Design of Imaging Radar based on Silicon Millimeter Wave Transceiver Chip
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Millimeter wave radar has a wide development prospect in automotive safety, security inspection imaging, etc. Due to the rapid development of semiconductor technology, millimeter wave radar based on silicon chip has become a research hotspot. The Tianjin University research team has designed a 140GHz wideband millimeter wave transceiver chip. This paper introduces a novel high resolution millimeter wave 3D imaging radar based on the chip. The key features of radar hardware are illustrated. The radar performance is predicted based on the current stage of development. The presented solution is simple and low cost, and can be used as the basis of millimeter wave array radar.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis method of accelerated life test data under constant stress
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Constant stress reliability accelerated life test is to select a group of accelerated stress level, a certain number of samples are divided into several groups, each group under a stress level life test, until each group has a certain number of samples failure. In this paper, the life characteristics under high stress level are used to extrapolate the life characteristics under normal stress level and to establish the relationship between life characteristics and stress level, under the lognormal distribution of a certain number of samples to complete statistical analysis of constant stress accelerated life test data, The confidence interval and confidence limit of the reliability index under the condition of fixed and timed truncation are obtained respectively, and the life distribution under normal stress level is obtained, and the estimation of each reliability index is calculated.

articleTitle: Radar Emitter Signal Recognition Based on PCA-ICS-SVM
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In this paper, a principal component analysis (PCA) based algorithm is proposed, which combines with improved Cuckoo Search (ICS) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Firstly, PCA is used to reduce the dimension of the eigenvalue, and then select the principal component with high contribution rate as the input vector of SVM for analysis. This paper also proposes a cuckoo algorithm which improves the search formula to find the optimal value of the key parameter penalty factor C and kernel function parameter g of SVM. The simulation results show that this method can obtain better recognition effect in the environment containing a certain amount of noise signals, which not only consumes a short time, but also has a higher recognition rate.

articleTitle: Workflow for simulating the single neuronal structure
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Neurons are the basic unit of brains, and their electrochemical reactions and movements in extracellular fluid may affect consciousness. In order to explore the cerebral activity, simulating the subtle structures of somata, dendrites, axons should be the fundamental work. In this paper, a workflow for simulation of single neurons aiming at the current reconstructed data is proposed, which can produce some valuable intermediates, such as 3-D voxelized images and continuous surface meshes, and analyze the force, speed, and motion position of micro structure in neurons. If the constraints actually meet the physical reality and properties of the neuronal material, the motion of a single neuron can be preeminently simulated. This paper shows a good simulation effect, which can adaptively generate data with different granularity according to scale of neurons. It has a great inspiration and promotion for future research work.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Proofreading System Based on Improved Phrase Translation Model
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In view of the fact that the English translation and proofreading system of syntax and phrase attaches importance to accuracy calibration and can not solve the problem of poor coherence, an intelligent proofreading system based on improved phrase translation model is proposed. First of all, translation algorithms based on phrases’ translation can create the models of semantic ontology. Furthermore, the general scheme systematic design is carried out through the overall architecture of the system. In order to improve the searches’ accuracy, it’s better to set search modules as the main parts of hardware. Software is required to support multi-language translations and proofreading. Thus, the modules of software should primarily include the system applications’ frameworks, network analysis situs, clients, the organizations and managements of translators, internet cooperative translations and other modules. The last procedure is to test the designed system. The testing results prove that those systems can fulfil the users’ needs of translation proofreading and raise greatly the efficiency of proofreading.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on students' classroom behaviour data based on LSTM
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In the subject, the research and analysis of big data individual behavior big data is helpful to the cultivation of students' ability and the improvement of teachers' teaching. This is also one of the key concerns of researchers in this field. This paper presents the modeling and analysis of students' classroom behavior data based on LSTM. The experimental results show that our method is helpful to the cultivation of College Students' ability and the improvement of teachers' teaching.

articleTitle: Research on a Trend Forecast Model of Time Series Data Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The prediction of stock price trends is of great significance in the study of time series. Based on deep learning, this paper combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) for feature extraction and a long short-term memory network (LSTM) for prediction, and proposes a 3dCNN-LSTM stock price trend prediction model. The three-dimensional input tensors of the model are the technical indicators of the stock index, the correlation between the stock indexes and the historical information of the time series. Among them, this paper converts the traditional technical indicators for predicting stock prices into trend-deterministic data, and secondly uses distance correlation coefficients to sort the stock indices, and designs a CNN module that can extract three-dimensional input features, and sets up simulation experiments under different conditions to determine the optimal parameters of the model. Through comparison with other prediction models, the results of simulation experiments show that the 3dCNN-LSTM model has a better prediction effect and improves the F1 measurement value.

articleTitle: Modeling the dynamics of interest rate policy: the dynamic impact of the chosen path of the nominal interest rate on the real interest rate
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Nominal interest rate policy is one of the most basic financial regulation tools in the world today. What kind of impact do interest rate hikes, rate cuts, and various central bank interest rate strategies have on the real economy? Are their effects policy stable? We construct differential equations containing the dynamics of four typical nominal interest rate strategies and real interest rates under the ideal assumption of a no-arbitrage economy and show the connection between them through system stability analysis and mathematical methods such as initial value selection and numerical simulation. The model reveals that the interest rate system is often unstable, the evolution curve of the real interest rate is highly sensitive to the path of the nominal interest rate, and the central bank cannot fix the nominal interest rate in the long run, and the four typical interest rate strategies can be flexibly switched in practice.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data in the reform of medical community performance distribution system and its impact on job satisfaction of medical staff
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The construction of the medical community is one of the most substantive actions in the medical reform, which aims to improve the efficiency of the allocation and use of medical resources. With the rapid development of modern network technology, big data and cloud computing technology, the construction of Internet Plus Medical Community has become an important means to build a regional medical center. By promoting the interconnection of information among medical and health institutions in the medical community, to create a technical basis for centralized and unified human, financial and material management, and to explore the establishment of a unified salary performance management and evaluation system for medical staff in the medical community. This paper discusses the application of Big Data in the reform of the medical community. By building a regional information platform, medical community organizations can establish a unified salary assessment system, which can fully mobilize the enthusiasm and satisfaction of medical staff. In the future, it is necessary to further establish a unified salary distribution system through the application of the big data platform to improve the fairness of medical staff's treatment.

articleTitle: Research on the external spatial vitality of traditional villages based on spatial syntax
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Using the method of spatial syntax theory, taking the traditional village Zhangdian village, Jiaxian County, Henan Province as an example, starting from the comparison between the village form before 1949 and the current situation, this paper makes a quantitative research and visual expression on the pedestrian flow in the main streets and lanes through the axis analysis at the macro level and the horizon analysis at the meso level, Through the survey data statistics and SPSS software, this paper makes a correlation analysis on the influencing factors of vitality points at the micro level, in order to objectively describe and analyze the current situation and influencing factors of the external space vitality of Zhangdian village from these three different scales, and explore the path of the spatial activation of traditional villages on this basis, In order to provide some useful help in the face of the decline of traditional villages under the influence of urbanization.

articleTitle: Authentication scheme of equipment management system based on lightweight block cipher algorithm
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the development of information technology, building an intelligent equipment system is receiving more and more attention. In this paper, a two-way authentication and information protection scheme based on lightweight encryption technology is proposed for the equipment management system, which establishes identity-based equipment authentication while ensuring the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information. And the scheme applies to the resource-constrained environment, meets the requirements for the safe use of equipment, and solves the security problems caused by threats such as replay and tracking during information transmission.

articleTitle: Fuzzy expert compensation controller for converters based on down slag images
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Based on the large number of domestic converters and the fact that many of them are statically regulated, a targeted combination of image processing and other technologies is used to improve the shortcomings of static regulation and to develop a steel quality evaluation model for converters with a high hit rate that is suitable for the field environment. The output of the steel quality evaluation model is combined with the expert knowledge of the converter smelting process and the process data to establish a fuzzy expert compensation controller based on data fusion for the initial batching of converter steel, which can adjust the initial batching of the next furnace, so as to improve the one-pour hit rate, shorten the melting cycle and reduce the cost.

articleTitle: An optimization of code pairs for Beidou and GPS signals from the perspective of Shipborne GNSS receiver
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: High performance shipborne GNSS receiver with strong anti-interference ability and supporting compatibility and interoperability becomes more and more popular. The impact of data/pilot cross-correlation on code tracking performance is investigated, considering the characteristics of Beidou and GPS signals. Based on the code set given by the interface control document (ICD), the optimized code pairs optimization for the Beidou and GPS signals are presented. The optimized data/pilot code pairs could significantly mitigate the intra-channel (i.e., data/pilot) codes cross-correlation, and then improve the code tracking performance of the Beidou and GPS signals.

articleTitle: Key Points of Design and Application of Short-range Low-power Wireless Communication System Based on Si4438
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Short-range low-power wireless communication system has been widely used in modern intelligent equipment because of its technical advantages of relatively low cost and energy consumption. Si4438 is a commonly used RF transceiver chip in short-range low-power wireless communication system. It not only has good low-power performance, but also can simplify the peripheral circuit structure and effectively control power. In this paper, the author will design and develop the short-range low-power wireless communication system based on Si4438 chip, and take the application of short-range wireless communication system in intelligent meter reading as an example to discuss the application of short-range low-power wireless communication system based on Si4438, so as to promote the development of wireless communication system and related chip technology in China.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Virtual Reality in the Treatment of Autism
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Virtual reality is a technology in the field of computer. It is found that it has better pertinence and applicability in the treatment of mental diseases, especially autism patients. The traditional ASD treatment is based on special education and rehabilitation training. Larger human interference can relieve symptoms, but the effect of improving social skills and communication skills is not obvious, and the willingness of patients to interact is not high. Emerging virtual reality technology breaks through the limitations of traditional intervention methods. VR technology simulates various scenarios. Realism and high security can in turn be adjusted for personalization. In this paper, the literature on the application of virtual reality technology in the treatment of autism in recent years was searched through literature navigation. This article reviews the impact of virtual reality technology on social functioning, emotional intervention, and motor skills in individuals with autism. At the same time, due to the immersion of virtual technology, it is more beneficial for autistic children to transfer acquired skills into reality than general flat visual intervention. Nonetheless, the application of virtual reality technology in the rehabilitation of children with autism still faces many challenges.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Curriculum Knowledge Graph Based on GMM
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The knowledge hierarchy provided by the curriculum syllabus is the basic principle for the implementation of course teaching and assessment, which usually summarizes knowledge units into a tree-like hierarchical structure in the form of chapters. But it cannot supply the complete picture of knowledge relationships because of the lack of horizontal connections between knowledge units in it. In order to present the characteristics of knowledge units and the many-to-many relationships between them comprehensively and accurately. This paper proposes a method for the construction of course knowledge structures from the massive test question bank with the Gaussian Mixture Clustering model. This method employs the Gaussian Mixture Clustering model to find the knowledge units and their associations from a large number of test questions, then employs the knowledge graph technology to make the course Knowledge Graph, and construct the curriculum knowledge hierarchy. Extensive empirical research focuses on the physics course in eighth grade (first) course in junior high school. Experimental results demonstrate that the constructed curriculum knowledge hierarchy of the physics course is complete and effective. Furthermore, the average coverage of some random final test papers is 89.2%.

articleTitle: Vulnerability mining for DoIP based on weighted mutation for combined fields
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Remote diagnostic services based on DoIP protocols provide convenience for vehicle bootloader and diagnostics but inevitably posing a potential risk to automotive information security. Therefore, it is of practical importance to perform the security testing of DoIP implementations. The use of existing fuzzing frameworks for network protocol is blind and requires high computing resources for vehicle devices. To address the above problems, a weighted mutation for combined fields is proposed, combined with depth-first search algorithm for protocol state machine traversal to form a two-layer data generation strategy. Further, the weight matrix is adjusted during test iterations based on a feedback mechanism to optimize the quality of the test case set, ultimately ensuring fuzz efficiency despite limited test resources.

articleTitle: Chinese named entity recognition using adversarial training and attention mechanism
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Chinese NER plays an important role in natural language processing as a fundamental task. The current character-based training approach for Chinese NER suffers from the inability to incorporate overall sentence features or character neighbourhood features into the character vector. In this paper, we designed a feature enhancement module with attention mechanism and BI-LSTM networks to enhance the feature extraction capability of the model and proposed the introduction of adversarial training as a method of enhancing data to improve the robustness of the model. It has been proven through extensive experiments that the accuracy of the model in Chinese NER task has been improved after the introduction of the adversarial training and feature enhancement modules. In our experiments, we choose the BERT-CRF network as our baseline model.

articleTitle: Based on Big Data of the Role of Mother Tongue Transfer in English Acquisition from the Perspective of Markedness Theory
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Mother tongue transfer is one of the most important topics in second language acquisition. Both linguistic and cognitive theories involve markedness theory into the study of mother tongue transfer. Linguistic theories compare the markedness differences between mother tongue and the target language and study the possibilities of mother tongue transfer. Cognitive theories are based on the typical categories of mother tongue characteristics and analyse the selections of native language transfer by language learners. It is quite common that language learners are inclined to make negative transfer in the process of communication in the target language. Therefore, the proposition of markedness theory has profound and lasting implications for language teaching and learning. Based on big data, this paper focusing on the markedness theory aims to target both the positive and negative transfer to help enhance students’ understanding and mastery of the target language.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Health diagnosis and Traceability analysis of Database system
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the development of enterprise digitization, a large number of information systems have been put into all aspects of the production process, and are closely integrated with the production process. As the core component of the information system, the database system is needed to be able to ensure stable operation and quick recovery after failure. In this paper, through the research of database system traceability analysis and the construction of causal relationship set, it forms the database system abnormal fast analysis and positioning method, for database system operation automation and intelligent exploration practice. Finally, the feasibility of the method is verified by the simulated environment function test, and to a certain extent, the anomaly analysis efficiency of the database system is improved, the technical threshold of operation and maintenance engineers is reduced, and the operation and maintenance cost is saved.

articleTitle: Applications and convergence of optimal control theory in clinically-relevant research
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Optimal control theory is a major branch of modern control theory which concentrates on finding the fundamental conditions and comprehensive methods to optimize the performance index of a control system. Due to the universality of optimal control theory and the substantial development of computing power, the theory developed rapidly. In recent years, optimal control theory has appeared to be applied to the medical field. In this paper presented here, we analyse the achievements of optimal control theory in the field of clinical science by evaluating the advantages and drawbacks of three main applications, then we summarize the development trends of the theory in the medical field. At present, there are relatively few applications of optimal control theory in the field of clinical science in China. This paper should provide some theoretical references for researchers when tackling with clinical conditions that limit human mobility.

articleTitle: Integrated and intelligent space launch information system based on cloud native
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the intensive growth of space launch missions and the development and application of new technologies. The demand for multi task parallel and joint application of multiple launch centers is becoming more and more urgent. The requirements for the automation, scalability and reliability of the space launch information system are becoming higher and higher. The original information system running independently based on monolithic architecture is no longer suitable. In order to meet the needs of high-density space launch missions, it is necessary to build an integrated and intelligent space ground information system. This paper reviews and summarizes the development history of the space launch ground information system, analyses the requirements of the space launch mission for the ground information system. The architecture of the ground information system is researched, constructs business services and data services based on cloud computing, microservice and container technology, and designs an integrated space ground information system shared by multiple launch centers. The system is safe, reliable, flexible and scalable and lay a foundation for the construction of ground information system and provide solutions. Improve the intelligent analysis level, command automation level and comprehensive display level of the space launch center.

articleTitle: Research on the Integration System of Book Information Resources Based on Metadata
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: At present, in the management of book resources, the importance of the integration of book information resources is further enhanced. In order to improve the integration effect of book information resources, it is more important to optimize and improve the book information resource integration system based on the concept and the method of metadata. To this end, the article starts from hardware design and software design, and discusses in detail how to design a new book information resource integration system based on the concept and the method of metadata, in order to improve work efficiency and quality.

articleTitle: The Research on Analyzing the Number of Signal Definitions of In-Vehicle CAN Networks
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In recent years, automotive cyber security has attracted widespread attention as vehicles continue to suffer from cyber attacks. Some of these attacks aim to penetrate into in-vehicle CAN networks such that the underlying vehicle could be controlled. Intrusion detection systems are then proposed for in-vehicle networks. However, the application of related security methods and tools is hindered by the non-uniform format of proprietary message definitions of in-vehicle networks. To solve the above problem, this paper proposes a method for identifying and analyzing the number of bus protocol signal definitions. The method performs classification by extracting frequency features and finally obtains the number of signal definitions. The experimental results show that the method can effectively identify the number of signal definitions, which is important and promising for reverse analysis of bus messages in subsequent security research.

articleTitle: Research on the design of Chaoshan intelligent tableware based on digital image processing technology
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Smart tableware is a tool produced along with smart catering. It is a smart food container designed based on the Internet of Things, cloud computing and artificial intelligence technology through new technologies and information technology. Based on digital image processing technology, this paper develops and designs smart tableware, introduces the digital image calibration principle and sampling quantification method adopted by Chaoshan smart tableware, and then uses image segmentation and binarization analysis, color digital image processing and analysis technology to explore The abstract beauty of Chaoshan smart tableware. The development of this creative product not only brings convenience to our use, but also a symbol of our cultural innovation.

articleTitle: Research and Application Core Inquiry of Communication Data Management System Based on Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the increasing variety of communication services, the operation and maintenance cost of big data platform is constantly increasing. In order to improve the security and application performance of the big data management system, it is necessary to deeply study the communication data management system based on the big data platform in the communication business system. After investigating the current data management system, it is found that there are some problems such as insufficient lightweight and insufficient timeliness of data migration. Therefore, it is necessary to design a big data management platform that can run efficiently and be convenient to use. In the specific design process, it is necessary to design different modules such as interface acquisition, program scheduling, data aggregation, platform alarm, marketing analysis and visualization based on the process of big data processing and the architecture of communication big data platform. During the operation of the management system, data mining and analysis can be completed in depth, which is of positive significance to improve the overall application level of the communication data management system.

articleTitle: Design of a real-time image edge detection system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: This paper describes the design idea and flow of a digital image processing system based on FPGA that can capture, process and display in real time, analyses the timing of the camera interface; explains the principle of capturing image information; describes in detail the functions of each module in the image edge detection part; focuses on the design of the median filter module with noise removal function; briefly describes the edge detection operator The system is based on a physical FPGA development board. The system is based on a solid FPGA development board to achieve real-time image data acquisition, real-time edge detection and real-time display, with stable operation and high real-time performance, thus also demonstrating that FPGAs do have the capability of high-speed transmission of massive data.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of secure access technology for distribution terminal
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: As more and more distribution terminals are connected to the distribution automation network, it brings great risks to the distribution network. The security access of distribution terminals has become a key issue in power information security. In this paper, by analyzing the security risk of distribution terminal access, aiming at the security requirements of intelligent distribution network, this paper researches and implements the security access protection technology of intelligent distribution terminal based on security encryption algorithm, and realizes the connection between the main station and terminal of intelligent distribution network. It solves the security problem during the access process of the smart power distribution terminal, and ensures that the smart power distribution terminal can securely access the intranet as a safe and trusted internal user. In this paper, a secure encryption algorithm combining RSA and AES is proposed. The AES algorithm is used to encrypt and transmit data, and the RSA algorithm is used to encrypt and transmit the AES key. Combining the respective characteristics of the two encryption algorithms, the advantages and disadvantages are avoided.

articleTitle: A modeling method of ship resident rule based on big data platform
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The massive AIS data recorded in the course of shipping contains resident law information. Considering the ship type, the intention of ship activity can be analyzed based on resident law or abnormal behavior can be monitored. At present, the analysis of ship residence law relies on expert artificial reasoning, which makes it difficult to deal with massive data. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes an analysis method of resident rule based on big data platform. It makes full use of the computing power of Spark, analyzes AIS data through density-based clustering algorithm, and gives the resident rule of ships. Experimental results show that the proposed method can quickly analyze the resident rules of multi-scene and multi-type ships.

articleTitle: Research on the design of data visualization management platform based on smart elderly care community
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In order to solve a series of problems in the existing community pension model, such as low level of intelligent management, poor suitability for the elderly in public spaces, unclear boundaries of community work, and lack of accurate guidance. By sorting out the problems of the existing community pension model, and combining the physiological and psychological characteristics of the elderly residents, this research designs the business framework of the smart pension community management platform, and visualizes the business data through the information visualization design. A set of community data visualization management platform integrating four major sectors: smart service, smart medical treatment, smart supervision, and smart early warning has been built. Through the intervention of the management platform, the community service process is optimized, the community supervision efficiency is improved, the community early warning time is shortened, and the community medical system is standardized, which provides feasible suggestions for the smart elderly care community model.

articleTitle: An Attention Neural Network for Radar Intra-pulse Modulation Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The most existing Low Probability of Intercept (LPI) radar signal recognition algorithms generally have poor recognition performance due to the extraction of radar intra-pulse modulation features at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is difficult. To solve that issue, this paper proposes a novel attention neural network based on the time-frequency images (TFIs) for intra-pulse modulation pattern recognition of radar pulse signals. First, in order to obtain the TFIs from the radar received signals with low cross-terms and high time-frequency resolution, smoothed pseudo Wigner-Ville distribution (SPWVD) is leveraged for generating the TFIs from the received radar signals. Second, Block-matching and 3D filtering (BM3D) is utilized to preprocess the TFIs to eliminate the impact of the background noise for preserving detailed features of the signal, and then we adopt bilinear interpolation algorithm in terms of obtaining the TFIs with the same size for further network training. Finally, the pre-processed TFIs are fed into the deep neural network embedded with SENet attention module, which is called SE-ResNet, to do the recognition. SENet can help the model extract valid feature of TFIs and achieve effective recognition on different radar signal intra-pulse modulation patterns from LPI radar. The simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve an overall recognition rate of 93.2% for eight LPI radar signals when SNR in a low SNR environment, e.g., -8 dB.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Education Platform based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Following the advancements made during the information age, information technology has found more use in colleges. The Internet has provided new opportunities for higher education and broadened its platform. In order to ensure the harmony and stability of the colleges, it is necessary to strengthen management communication and maintain internal and external connections. Educational reforms based on information technology can enhance the efficiency of college education and management, thereby deepening their connection with students. Blockchain technology, a decentralized point-to-point architecture, performs digital authentication through data encryption, time stamping, and distributed consensus. It has the characteristics of decentralization, traceability, and non-tampering, and it can offer system security and traceability solutions for user behavior, enabling intelligent education. Therefore, this paper designs an Intelligent Education Platform based on Blockchain Technology to achieve centralized management of teacher, student, and enterprise information. The pressure tests of the system showed that the designed module functions could run normally and achieve the expected effects. This research has specific contributions to the follow-up development of intelligent education.

articleTitle: Data Theft Attack Detection Method for SDN Edge Switch
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: As a device for data forwarding and policy enforcement, the permissions of SDN switches should not be stolen by unauthorized entities. Such requirement cannot be met because there are compromised switches in data plane due to malicious attacks. This paper proposes a data theft attack initiated by edge switches, which can evade network-wide anomaly detection. In this paper, we address this problem and propose a flow information consistency detection method. The host completes the information transmission with the controller through the packet_in message mechanism by constructing special packet, and the controller performs flow information consistency authentication on the flow table entry request message to detect anomalies. Finally, this paper conducts experiments on the mininet platform based on the ryu controller. The experimental results show that this method can only increase the time cost slightly (1%-2%) while resisting the attack of the edge switch.

articleTitle: A Rolling Bearing Fault Detection Method Based on Heterogeneous Fusion Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: To research the problems of the rolling bearing fault diagnosis under variable loads, a dual-input model of rolling bearing fault detection based on heterogeneous fusion deep network was proposed, which was trained based the data set after incremental processing by the sliding window frame. The accuracy of the model was 96.05% in the test set. Compared with single convolution branch network and non-convolution branch network, the proposed method not only ensured the excellent accuracy in test set, but also enhanced the stability of training process. In addition, the test accuracy of the model under different loads was about 96%. The proposed model achieved a high fault recognition rate under variable load as well as satisfactory load adaptability.

articleTitle: The Application of Virtual Reality Technology to Exposure Treatment of Patients with Post-traumatic Stress Disorder
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: As a new technology developed in recent years, virtual reality technology (VRT) has been widely used in medical treatment, business, education and other fields due to its immersion, interaction, imagination and other characteristics with the continuous improvement of technical level and the reduction of the price of virtual reality (VR) equipment. At present, VRT has broad application prospects in the medical field, especially in psychotherapy. Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a mental disorder. Usually, it is a condition of persistent mental and emotional stress occurring as a result of injury or severe psychological shock. Positive intervention and induction are the key to treatment and prevention of PTSD. As one of cognitive-behavioural therapy, exposure therapy (ET) is the most common and effective psychotherapy for PTSD. However, such traditional psychotherapy is difficult to meet the needs of modern treatment, and the application of VRT--virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET), has become an emerging treatment method for PTSD, showing a real, controllable and acceptable unique advantages. Its procedures and psychological mechanism meet the requirements of PTSD exposure therapy, and speed up the process of psychotherapy.

articleTitle: Application of artificial intelligence technology in depression and suicide management
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Research significance: Depression is a common mental disorder with the characteristics of high morbidity, high disability rate, and high suicide rate. Depression is relatively difficult to diagnose, treat, monitor and manage. In recent years, with the emergence of artificial intelligence technology, it has provided new means for depression and suicide management. Based on the current situation of depression and suicide, this paper discusses the current application results of artificial intelligence in depression diagnosis, depression and suicide monitoring and management, and treatment intervention, so as to provide reference for related research on depression and suicide management based on artificial intelligence technology. Research methods: Search the literature on the application of artificial intelligence technology in depression intervention in recent years through literature navigation. Depression diagnosis, depression monitoring, depression intervention and other aspects were analyzed. The actual technology was compared in the children's motor skills, social interaction, daily life and casual attention. Research conclusion: Artificial intelligence technology is developing rapidly, and it has great advantages over traditional technology in the treatment of depression, but AI still has a lot of room for development, and it also has shortcomings at this stage, because machine learning algorithms are easier to Affected by biases such as racist and sexist rhetoric, key industry players need to ensure the robustness of their AI systems before bringing them to market.

articleTitle: Comparison between different frameworks in Visual Object Tracking
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In recent years, deep learning-based visual tracking has flourished and a number of advances have been made. Numerous frameworks have been proposed to improve the accuracy and robustness. In this paper, we focus on introducing several different modified methods of visual tracking. We summarize the tracking framework as Siamese network, and correlation filter based methods. We review 10 distinguish methods published recently. We state that our review aims to provide an in-depth introduction on visual object tracking, which can guide the beginners to fast recognize this task.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Computer-Aided Translation Software Trados and Wordfast
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The vigorous development of computer-aided translation technology has enabled the translation industry to move from the "paper and pencil era" to the "information age". Taking SDL Trados Studio 2017 and Wordfast Professional editions as examples, this paper compares the two software from localization translation memory, termbase and translation quality control, and further explores the three aspects of functionality, operability and compatibility. On the one hand, the core technologies of the two software packages are compared and discussed to help guide users in the most effective selection of the two packages. On the other hand, the usability of the two packages is compared and discussed to enable software learners to better understand and apply the two packages.

articleTitle: Inductive Network Representation based on Neighbor Aggregation
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Network representation learning is to learn low dimensional vectors for nodes. It plays a critical role in network analysis. However, most existing network embedding methods focus on embedding the nodes that already exist in the network, and cannot be generalized to newly-added nodes without retraining the learning model. To deal with this problem, the most common idea is to directly aggregate neighbor embeddings as the representation of new nodes, but this may lead to ignoring the particularity of node neighbors themselves. To fill this gap, we present INRL-NA, an innovative method of Inductive Network Representation Learning based on Neighbor Aggregation, which uses the hierarchical information to selectively aggregate neighbor node embeddings, preserving both the structural information and feature information of network. First we build a hierarchical network, then train a refinement model on the hierarchical network, finally after a new node joins the network, we use the hierarchical information and feature information to selectively aggregate neighbor embeddings. The experimental results show that compared with direct aggregation of all neighbor representations, INRL-NA has higher representation quality.

articleTitle: Classification of Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Based on Lightweight Network
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Breast cancer is a common cancer in female cancer patients, and histopathological image analysis is the gold standard for cancer diagnosis. Therefore, it is of great significance to use computer-aided diagnosis for automatic classification of breast cancer pathological images. Research in this direction mainly focuses on improving the recognition rate of breast cancer pathological images. This paper proposes a lightweight convolutional neural network named DgNet for the problem of network parameters and flops. The feature maps extracted from the existing convolutional neural networks have redundancy, and these redundancy can be obtained by linearly transforming the feature maps. This linear transformation of this feature map reduces the amount of parameters and flops of the network relative to the convolution operation. In addition, this paper also enhances and normalizes the data set to improve the recognition rate of the network for breast cancer pathological images. In the public dataset BreaKHis, the network in this paper achieves an average recognition rate of 95.87% for the benign and malignant binary classification of breast cancer pathological images. Experiments show that this paper achieves better results with fewer parameters and flops.

articleTitle: Research of network security analysis platform based on big data
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The rapid development of information networks has brought about an explosive growth in the amount of network data that creates challenges to network security. Therefore, it is quickly become a research hotspot in the academic community that using network security situational awareness technology to improve the timeliness and accuracy of network security situation assessment in big data environment. However, the current research does not pay much attention to the construction of the network platform.
