publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) plays an imperative role in the clinical diagnosis of heart disease and heart abnormalities. In order to obtain the original ECG signal morphology, the wavelet threshold technique is usually used for ECG signal de-noising, in which threshold function and thresholds play very important role. In this paper, an improved threshold function with adjustable shape parameter was structured to improve the problems of the constant deviation in soft threshold function and the discontinuousness in hard threshold function. And then, an optimization strategy based on artificial bee colony algorithm with mean square error (MSE) as the objective function is embedded into the process of de-noising to quickly determine the optimal shape parameter and thresholds. Subsequently, a series of the simulation experiment are carried out by using two benchmark signals and real ECG signal with different noise levels. The signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and the MSE after de-noising are used as evaluation index of the proposed method. The evaluation results demonstrate that the improved threshold function shows a better performance than the traditional threshold functions under different noise levels, and the proposed method is effective for the selections of the optimal shape parameter and thresholds in ECG signal de-noising.

articleTitle: Application of artificial intelligence in urban intelligent traffic management system
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: As China’s economy continues to grow, so does the transportation system. At the same time, the rapid increase of vehicles and the lack of road construction will lead to increasing traffic problems, which require more intelligent transportation concepts. In this paper, we will analyze the current specific application of artificial intelligence technology in intelligent transportation, and make judgments on the future occasions that artificial intelligence may be utilized in urban intelligent transportation management based on the development of cities and the trend of artificial intelligence development in recent years, and comprehensively analyze the development status and trend of urban intelligent transportation management system, in order to play an enlightening role in the future development of smart cities in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of high-quality economic development in the Yangtze River Economic Belt based on the correction factor TOPSIS
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Based on the connotation of high-quality economic development, a multi-indicator evaluation system is constructed from five dimensions of innovation, coordination, green, openness and sharing. The improved TOPSIS method is used to measure the level of high-quality economic development in the Yangtze River Economic Belt from 2015 to 2019. The results show that: the economic quality development level is on an upward trend and shows a gradual momentum from east to west. And obvious differences exist between the middle and upper reaches and the downstream, but the gap is gradually narrowing. Finally, corresponding suggestions are put forward to promote the coordinated development of various provinces and cities.

articleTitle: A hybrid neural network model for predicting charges by incorporating legal knowledge
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The charge prediction task is one of the hot research topics in legal intelligence. Its main objective is to assist judges in case decision-making by using the given case and then predicting the charges. Nowadays, introducing a deep learning framework to solve the legal intelligence topic is the mainstream approach. We propose data augmentation by incorporating knowledge of the law articles and combining it with the ERNIE_DPCNN hybrid model to enhance the charge prediction to the best effect through extensive research on legal documents. Moreover, we combine the Integrated Gradient to interpretability analysis of the prediction model to analyze the charge prediction results. In this paper, we use the accuracy rate, recall rate, and F1 value evaluation indexes for evaluation, and the experimental results show that the method can effectively predict the charges for legal cases.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Personal Credit Risk Assessment Index System based on PCA
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Building a scientific and comprehensive personal credit risk assessment system is the key to accurately assessing personal credit risk. This paper selects the credit data of the Lending Clue online loan platform in the third quarter of 2017 for empirical research, uses principal component analysis (PCA) to screen credit evaluation indicators, establishes a support vector machine (SVM) model and an artificial bee colony algorithm to optimize the SVM parameter model (ABC-SVM) for verification. The results show that the principal component analysis method can effectively reduce the dimension, eliminate irrelevant variables and redundant variables, and improve the prediction accuracy of personal credit evaluation.

articleTitle: Design and application of computer application basic examination system based on Web
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In the national college education and teaching reform, from campus management to education and teaching as well as examination and assessment are showing the development trend of network and information. Network examination system based on Web for the specialty of computer based test, focuses on two aspects of theoretical knowledge and practical operation of students with collaborative evaluation, through the network exam system can quickly and accurately reflect students mastery of basic computer knowledge content and practical operating ability, meet the needs of the present colleges and universities cultivate well-rounded talents with high quality. At the same time, it can also realize the functions of automatically setting questions, adjusting the difficulty of examination papers, automatically scoring and handing in papers by time, which greatly improves the work efficiency, increases the pertinence and flexibility of the examination, and promotes the comprehensive reform of college education.

articleTitle: Design and Prospect of Power Financial Derivatives in New Power System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The introduction of electricity financial derivatives can not only provide market participants with means to avoid price risk, but also increase market trading volume by introducing speculators into the electricity market, so that the market can play the role of price discovery. Based on big data research, this paper puts forward four trading modes of power financial derivatives: power forward, power futures, power options and differential contracts, and analyzes them to solve the problem of price risk aversion in China 's power market.

articleTitle: Minefield Detection System Based on Unmanned Airborne UWB-GPSAR
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Due to the wide distribution, large area and complex terrain of the minefield, it is difficult for most detection equipment to detect safely, efficiently and accurately. Therefore, an unmanned airborne UWB-GPSAR minefield detection system composed of ground control part, flight control part and radar detection part is designed in this paper. Aiming at the problem of detection data error caused by air flow on the four rotor UAV platform, an improved RD algorithm with angle and height compensation is proposed. The simulation comparison shows that the improved RD algorithm can effectively optimize the detection accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Application analysis of data quality verification system based on resource management platform
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the rapid development of China's telecom industry, the business is more and more network resources being unwound, data growth speed faster and faster, data scale is becoming more and more large, then the data quality problem is increasingly serious, how to efficient use of existing resources, to provide a set of scientific and effective data management solutions, has become a network resources competitiveness indispensable important segment. This paper takes the application of data quality verification system of resource management platform as the main research object, discusses from system design, software architecture, database design, system function application and network resource related business, and puts forward a series of feasible schemes about data governance.

articleTitle: A Radar Pulse Sorting Algorithm Based on Mean Shift Clustering
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: A radar pulse sorting algorithm based on mean shift clustering for the high density electromagnetic pulses is proposed in this paper. The Fast Fourier Transformation is applied to the signal received by the reconnaissance aircraft, and the pulse description words are input to the improved mean shift clustering algorithm, which is an iterative clustering algorithm based on the kernel density gradient estimation and no parameter fast pattern matching. After the mean shift algorithm calculation, the classification results of radar pulse and the pulse description words of each type of radar pulse are obtained.

articleTitle: Application of CAID in Product Form Design of Aquaculture Vessel
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Aquaculture vessels need to have excellent product form on the basis of solving the problems of fish breeding, water quality detection and fish health detection. This paper proposes an efficient computer-aided modeling design framework of aquaculture vessel to complete the rapid iteration of hull form design. This study integrates engineering design and evaluation research, and makes an empirical study on the overall shape design in the stage of product development. The case application successfully demonstrates that product from design process combined with the framework strategy of CAID, it can provide good results in predicting design decision-making. This framework can be used as a new design decision-making method to guide design practice and provide supporting objective data, so as to reduce the influence of subjectivity, one-sided and superficiality in decision-making. With the application of CAID technology, the aquaculture vessel design project has finally achieved excellent product appearance design.

articleTitle: Next POI Recommendation based on Multi-graph Information Fusion and Attention Network
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Next point of interest (POI) recommendation aims to model the user's check-in sequence and help users find the POI they are interested at the next moment. Recurrent neural network (RNN)-based methods have been widely used in next POI recommendation, but these RNN-based methods lack in-depth model of complex semantic relationships and deeper sequence transition relationships. We propose next POI recommendation based on multi-graph information fusion and attention network, named MGINAN. Experimental results on two real datasets demonstrate that our proposed method has better recommendation performance than baseline methods.

articleTitle: Bibliometric analysis on gene editing using Bibliometrix an R Package
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: This study aims to explore some research activities in gene editing field by bibliometric analysis. Gene editing is a new and more accurate genetic engineering technology or process that can modify the specific target genes of organism genome. It has been applied in basic theoretical research and production applications, which contributes to many fields of life science, from the study of plant and animal gene function to human gene therapy. Through bibliometric analysis, we can learn about the annual published papers, influential authors, cooperation of research institutions and the evolution of topics in this field. We selected Science Citation Index Expanded (SCI-Expanded) from the core collection of Web of Science (WoS) database and retrieved 19449 articles from 1900 to 2020. The analysis results indicate gene editing as a scientific research field is growing steadily. Many institutions pay more attention to the development of gene editing technology. ZHANG F is the most influence author. In recent years, the research topics are CRISPR / CAS, gene editing, apoptosis and gene therapy.

articleTitle: Research on customer service conversation classification technology based on multi-source information
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: At present, Meituan uses the BERT model to perform binary classification judgments on customer service conversations. The input form of the conversation is often to convert the text in the form of a dialogue into a sentence/short text as the input of the model, and the downstream is often a single-sentence classification task. Inputs in the form of paragraphs have some flaws, such as the model’s inability to recognize the role attribution of sentences. And the sentence in the form of dialogue is different from the complete text, there is no continuity before and after. In response to the above problems, we propose a pre-trained model text classification algorithm based on fusion of multi-source information. By integrating role information and keyword information, the model indicators are improved. Finally, the feasibility of the improvement is verified by comparing the experimental results and analyzing the improvement effect.

articleTitle: Research on Development Trend and Measurement Method of Alternating Force Measurement Technology
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The need for dynamic force measurement in the field of mechanical quantity measurement is increasing day by day. However, the current measurement accuracy of dynamic force is still very low, far from meeting people's requirements for high-precision dynamic force measurement. Therefore, it is very important to eliminate the dynamic measurement error and improve the measurement accuracy in the dynamic force measurement.

articleTitle: Handwritten digit recognition algorithm based on DBN and improved KNN algorithm
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm is widely used in handwritten digit recognition technology because it has the characteristics of no data input assumption, high accuracy and insensitivity to outliers, but the space complexity and computational complexity of KNN algorithm are relatively high. The deep belief nets (DBN) deep learning model has excellent classification performance and is widely used in speech recognition, image recognition and other fields. Handwriting recognition technology is a technology derived from machine learning. The primary task of handwritten number recognition technology is to digitize images. This article integrates the DBN deep learning model into the KNN algorithm, and proposes a handwritten number recognition system based on the improved KNN algorithm. The test results show that the performance of the algorithm is significantly better than the traditional KNN algorithm and DBN algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on spatiotemporal heterogeneity and flow characteristics of dockless bike-sharing big data in riding demand
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Dockless bike-sharing system brings a new urban transportation mode, and users can expediently start and end riding in areas that do not exceed the stopping range. Analyzing the spatiotemporal characteristics in its usage through bike-sharing big data can provide fine-grained insights into urban dynamics. In this study, from the perspective of singular value decomposition and complex network, the spatio-temporal heterogeneity and flow characteristics of riding demand in dockless bike-sharing under the normalization of epidemic prevention and control are explored. Research shows that: 1) There are various riding demand patterns in the use of shared bicycles. The space-time matrix can be well decomposed through SVD, and the spatial and temporal heterogeneity of the demand patterns can be visualized significantly. Among them, the three with the largest proportion are daily basic demand, strong morning peak demand and evening peak demand. 2) Shared bicycles show multiple hotspots in cycling network space, the use of shared bicycles is mainly concentrated in the west of Shenzhen, forming an ellipse that is rotated 45deg counterclockwise. 3) Combo algorithm can divide the cycling network to an excellent degree, maximize the connection within the community and reduce the connection between the communities. After lots of iterations, 17 communities are detected, and the modularity reaches 0.831. Areas with large clustering coefficients are more likely to form community centers, several adjacent administrative streets form the same community, and the boundary of the administrative street forms the community boundary.

articleTitle: Improved image reconstruction of multi-scale residual network
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Since the existing image reconstruction algorithms using convolutional neural networks cannot extract more feature information well, and the reconstructed image is prone to the problems of edge sawtooth effect and detail blur. Therefore, an image super-resolution reconstruction method based on multi-scale residual network is brought up. Firstly, the different scale features of the input image is abstracted by the multi-scale feature module. Secondly, the deeper image information is further extracted by the residual dense module, and the cross-channel interaction is realized by combining the onedimensional convolution attention mechanism to pay attention to the crucial information. Finally, the image reconstruction is completed by sub-pixel convolution.

articleTitle: Research on BDS B1C Signal Synchronization Method
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: An obvious feature of modern navigation signal is that they have pilot components and data components. BDS B1C signal contains two components based on different power distribution ratios, and the B1C signal synchronization research becomes a key of the current stage of navigation receiver. Firstly the principle is analyzed based on the deconstruction of the mathematical model of B1C signal, then the signal matched synchronization and BOC(1,1)-Like synchronization method are compared. The signal processes combined with ASPeCT and Bump-Jump in the acquisition, and secondly the tracking simulation analysis is carried out. The simulation results show that the BOC(1,1)-Like method can achieve similar results with the matching method under the condition of -20dB SNR. The carrier tracking accuracy is also similar, but the code tracking accuracy differs 0.092, which used under the condition of low precision.

articleTitle: A Fast Signal Bandwidth Design Method for Millimeter Wave Planet Landing Radar
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Signal bandwidth is one of the important parameters of a millimeter wave planet landing radar (MwPLR). This paper proposes a fast bandwidth design method for MwPLR. The design method considers three main types of factors affecting the range accuracy, including thermal noise ranging error, terrain undulation error and range quantization error. And the signal bandwidth design is carried out quickly by solving a system of cubic equations, which is suitable for computeraided automatic design implementation. This method has been successfully applied in the design of Mars landing radar, which has helped China's Tianwen-1 Mars rover land successfully on Mars in May 2021.

articleTitle: Mesh generation of neuron cell body
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In 3D printing and biological simulation, it is essential to work to generate a high-quality three-dimensional mesh of the neuron. In previous work, simple geometry often represents cell body local mesh, which loses the actual cell body shape. This paper proposes an algorithm combining the marching cubes method and image segmentation method to make the cell body mesh have simulation characteristics and promote the further study of neurons. The mesh stitching algorithm fused the cell body and neurite mesh to obtain the whole brain neural element mesh. Experiments verify the feasibility and stability of the algorithm and verify the simulation characteristics of the generated cell body mesh.

articleTitle: Research on Hardware Controller of BLDC Motor Rehabilitation Robot Based on STM32
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Taking the DC brushless motor as the controlled object and STM32F103VET6 as the core, the design of the controller hardware circuit is carried out. The circuit mainly includes PWM drive circuit composed of IR2110, inverter circuit composed of IRFP250, Hall position detection circuit, current detection circuit, etc. The system uses current feedback and rotor position feedback to realize double closed-loop control of the motor. The controller has a VR virtual device interface for healing and fun. MATLAB/Simulink is used to simulate, and the fuzzy PID is used to compare with the traditional PID. The experimental results show that the fuzzy PID has faster response speed, better stability and less overshoot than the traditional PID, which can meet the control performance requirements of the rehabilitation lower limb robot.

articleTitle: Application development of external carbon source in low carbon source sewage treatment based on a large amount of literatures
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The influent carbon and nitrogen of most sewage plants in China are relatively low, which affects the anaerobic denitrification process of biological secondary treatment, resulting in high nitrogen content in effluent. Based on big data analysis, this paper analyzes the impact of external carbon sources (traditional carbon source, new solid carbon source and new liquid carbon source) on low-carbon source urban sewage treatment.

articleTitle: Study on fall warning system of elderly living alone based on OpenPose
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: The existing pension model is mainly divided into social pension and home pension. The latter are divided into old people living with their families or living alone. At present, the elderly at home account for a large proportion of the elderly, living alone is not a minority. Old people live alone for a variety of reasons. Some don't have family, some don't have family all the time. However, some of them choose to live on their own instead of going to a nursing home. Some of them are not allowed by their economic conditions, and some of them are worried that it is difficult for them to adapt to the traditional Chinese thinking that their home is their home. With the coming of the aging society, the number of elderly people living alone will continue to increase. How to provide more and better care for the elderly is a test of the degree of civilization of the society, and also a test of the work ability and level of relevant departments. This paper proposes an OpenPose based fall warning system for the elderly living alone to provide better care for the elderly, especially for the elderly living alone.

articleTitle: Improved indoor location algorithm based on Wi-Fi fingerprint and random forest
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Aiming at the influence of the similarity of Wi-Fi signal strength on indoor positioning, this paper proposes an improved indoor positioning algorithm based on Wi-Fi fingerprint and random forest. The algorithm uses Wi-Fi as a signal source to construct a Wi-Fi fingerprint library by receiving signal strength indication and basic service set identifiers, thereby establishing a random forest model for indoor location sensing. The simulation results show that the positioning error of the algorithm is about 2.26m. Compared with similar algorithms, it has better performance in execution time and positioning accuracy, and the accuracy of the algorithm is improved by about 3.2%.

articleTitle: Research on data visualization design of typhoon prevention power grid based on wind distribution map
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, map-based interactive system has been widely used. However, the research on meteorological map in our country is more embodied in computer science and mapping, and there is no systematic, normative and pertinent theoretical research on the basis of cognitive theory. Based on the spatial cognitive theory, this paper studies the visual representation of wind map, applies the wind map to the data visualization system of power grid, and designs a data visualization platform of typhoon protection network based on wind map. The design practice and results show that the data visualization system based on wind map can display the typhoon information more intuitively, improve the decision-making efficiency of power grid staff, and improve the typhoon prevention level of power grid system.

articleTitle: Research on data visualization design of poverty alleviation achievements based on echarts
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: As a supplement to the current poverty alleviation visualization, the existing poverty alleviation visualization charts can not quantify the difficulty of poverty alleviation in various counties and cities, and can not explore the data relevance. Taking the construction of a new data mapping relationship as the starting point, the visualization charts based on circular tree view are designed for the display of poverty alleviation achievements, and the web front-end echarts module is used to realize the visualization charts based on circular tree view, then import the data of China Poverty Alleviation database and Xinhua poverty alleviation map, and finally make an interactive visualization page of poverty alleviation achievements. Make another exploration on the visualization of poverty alleviation data.

articleTitle: Distance correction localization algorithm for wireless sensor networks based on RSSI
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Node self localization is the basis of target localization in wireless sensor networks. Wireless sensor network node location algorithms include distance based and distance independent. The location algorithm based on RSSI is widely used because of its simple implementation, but the ranging error of RSSI method is large, which affects the node location accuracy. A distance correction localization algorithm for wireless sensor networks based on RSSI is proposed. The algorithm calculates the position of the approximate centroid through RSSI ranging, takes it as the reference point for distance correction, and then determines the position of the node. Simulation results show that the algorithm can improve the node location accuracy.

articleTitle: A Proposed Siamese Convolutional Neural Network for Fingerprint Recognition
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In the past, the main way for fingerprint recognition was based on traditional image processing technology, which is timeconsuming and easy to fail. In order to recognize fingerprints more efficiently, in this experiment, the study proposed to use a method based on Siamese Network consisting of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which was seldom studied in the past. This experiment also is employed the idea of Multi-Scale Dilated Convolutions which can improve the receptive field and make each output of the Convolution contains a large amount of information. Dilated Convolutions introduces a hyper-parameter called dilation rate, which defines the spacing of values when Convolutional kernels process the data. This model added the three convolutional layers together which dilation rate equals 1, 2, 3 respectively to get dilated convolutions. This study input fingerprints and measured the similarity via output distance. The smaller the distance, the more similar the fingerprint and therefore it can judge if the fingerprints belong to the same person. The experimental results support this view.

articleTitle: Corporate Influence Analysis by Integrating Social Network Models
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: This study uses a social network model to analyze the influence of firms in the market from multiple perspectives. Corporate ownership relationships, the volume of securities traded, and the internationalization distribution of firms will be explored as three influential factors in this paper. Data visualization of the network using Gephi reveals that there is a multipolar sub-network of core firms in the corporate ownership network, and the sub-network has a star-shaped topology. In contrast, the securities trading network and the internationalization distribution network show an aggregated distribution of core firms, with most of the core firms clustered in the center of the total network, and have a de-extending influence on the edge nodes. The ‘networkx’ package in Python is used to analyze the centrality of the three different social networks, and it is found that Betweenness Centrality does not have practical significance in all networks, while Eigenvector Centrality, compared with Degree Centrality, varies much less in the stock exchange network than in the other two networks. Vary much less than the other two network models.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Sentence Error Correction Method in Thangka Field
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Text error correction is one of the research fields of natural language processing, which is applied in search engine, intelligent question answering, associative input and so on. At present, text error correction is mostly in the general domain, and there are few researches on the error correction of Thangka statements. This paper proposes a method of error correction of Thangka statements. Firstly, Thangka data is pre-processed to complete the training of language model and improve the efficiency and accuracy of text recognition. Then detect the suspected wrong position of the statement, and use domain confusion set, word granularity n-gram and word granularity n-gram to detect the wrong word. Finally, the candidate set of editing distance and phonetic/shape near word recall error correction were used, and the candidate results were sorted by the degree of confusion. The method proposed in this paper has a good application value in the field of Thangka error correction.

articleTitle: Improving Small Object Detection with Attention NMS
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Intersection over Union (IoU) and No-maximum suppression (NMS) are the basic fundamental components of state-of-the-art anchor-based object detectors. However, they have some defects. IoU, as a positioning evaluation measure, is inconsistent with the offset loss function of the bounding box, which may lead to inaccurate object positioning. Therefore, we draw lessons from the idea of Hausdorff distance, propose the distance perception module, and combine it with the original IoU to form a new regression evaluation measure. NMS is the post-processing module of object detectors. However, in the case of high overlap, relatively small objects may be lost. Therefore, we propose the Attention NMS algorithm (A-NMS) by considering the context information of location confidence. Finally, we embed DIoU and A-NMS into the mainstream object detector respectively. On the benchmark data set MS-COCO, we find that the performance of these detectors has been significantly improved. Through experiments, we find that DIoU and A-NMS can complement each other, and their cooperative use can further improve the performance of the detector.

articleTitle: Backscattering Characteristics of Millimeter Wave Landing Radar on Mars Surface
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: During the EDL (entry, descent and landing) prcess of the TianWen-1 Mars probe, the millimeter wave landing radar provides the GNC (Guidance, Navigation and Control) sub-system with high-precision ranging and velocity measurement data between the landing rover and the Martian surface to ensure the landing rover landing safely. The radar backscattering coefficient of Mars surface is the key characteristic parameter of the target detection, which directly affects the radar detection range and measurement accuracy, and is the most critical and uncertain parameter in the design process of millimeter wave landing radar. This paper proposes a method to calculate the radar scattering coefficient of Martian surface. This method, through setting up the mathematical model for radar scattering coefficient with incident angle, relief, and the components of the Martian surface. This radar scattering coefficient, is very important input for millimeter wave landing radar for range and precision analysis. At the same time, the backscattering coefficients obtained by electromagnetic calculation and in-orbit telemetry data inversion are compared and analyzed, which effectively verifies the correctness of the electromagnetic modeling of the radar backscattering coefficients of Mars surface, and provides a theoretical basis for the design and improvement for the deep-space landing radar.

articleTitle: Design of A Network Storage System Based on peer-to-peer Network with Supernode
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In the realm of computer network applications, the network storage service system is a hotspot for study. The massive and redundant computing and storage resources are abstracted into a file system-like form and made available to end users over the network, with the goal of greatly expanding end users' relatively limited storage resources and allowing them to effectively reduce storage resources and maintenance costs. The traditional network storage service system primarily uses a client-server architecture, which is reasonably easy to construct and maintain; however, there are some issues in the face of single point failure and high availability requirements under heavy demand, necessitating additional development. Based on the foregoing considerations, the use of traditional peer-to-peer networks in file sharing is first researched and summarized; based on this, a network storage system model based on peer-to-peer networks with super nodes is further proposed; then the file operating algorithms of common nodes and super nodes are provided. Based on the proposed algorithms, the realization and verified experiment has been demonstrated; then ultimately, the system's merits and weaknesses are summarized, leading to point out the future research directions.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network for English Character Recognition
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In the subject of image recognition, character recognition is a very active branch. On the one hand, the difficulty of the problem has made it a tough subject to study. Character recognition, on the other hand, is not a stand-alone application technology; it has some of the same fundamental and common issues as other fields of pattern recognition. Pattern recognition and image analysis have grown into a mature scientific discipline as a result of the rapid development of character recognition technology. In this paper, the recognition of handwritten English characters will be experimented with convolutional neural network (CNN) in order to achieve higher recognition accuracy. In the experiment, the preprocessing of NIST dataset will be completed first, and then the CNN model used in the experiment will be continuously optimized. By debugging the hyperparameters and observing the influence of different parameters on the experimental results (character prediction accuracy), the more suitable model parameters will be determined. The results of the experiment reveal that CNN is better at extracting visual features. When using a three-layer convolutional neural network to train a CNN model, the computational complexity of the model is reduced, and the final prediction accuracy is increased.

articleTitle: Lightweight YOLOv4 Coal Gangue Detection Method Based on Embedded Platform
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: A lightweight YOLOv4 coal gangue real-time detection method based on embedded platform is proposed for the problem that the current traditional gangue separation method cannot balance detection efficiency, reliability and safety. YOLOv4 consists of a backbone network, neck structure, and YOLO head. Firstly, a new Ghost-SE module is proposed. The SE module does a good job of weighting the network channels for better features. The Ghost module that can generate more feature maps with fewer parameters to improve the network’s learning ability. The two structures are integrated into the backbone network to further improve the detection performance. Then, the backbone network is redesigned to reduce the width and depth of the backbone network. In addition, the channel pruning method is used to prune the model and further compress the model. Compared with the original YOLOv4 experimental results, the number of parameters and the amount of calculation were reduced by 91.25 % and 87.73 %. The mAP(IoU=50:95) reaches 60.4%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Online Examination System Based on the Java Web
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: In view of the problem that the traditional paper exam or a single computer-based exam cannot meet the current teaching requirements for diversified exams, the design implementation of the Java Web-based online exam system is proposed, and the overall architecture design of the system is carried out by researching around the basic requirements functions, using software engineering, MVC framework -Struts, Hibernate framework and MYSQL database. The system achieves the goal of functional practicality, friendly interface and simple operation. Finally, the performance test of the system is completed by using software testing technology, and the test results show that the system can realize the functions of library building, paper formation, online examination, and paper reading in the three-dimensional process assessment, and can meet the requirements of the current course teaching for assessment and good performance.

articleTitle: Pavement crack detection method based on deep learning
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Pavement crack detection is an important step to achieve the task of pavement maintenance. Only by detecting pavement cracks in time can ensure road safety. Road crack detection has very important practical significance. This paper proposes to detect and extract road surface cracks based on deep learning, and based on the segmentation results, the crack types are classified and the crack area is quantitatively calculated. In this paper, after improving the ASPP module of the DeepLabV3+ network, the crack image is extracted, and then the extracted crack image is classified by the MobilenetV2 network, and finally it is quantified according to the quantization algorithm proposed in this paper. The experimental results show that the improved segmentation network has better extraction effect on crack images, the mIoU reaches 77.48%, the classification accuracy of the classification network for various types of cracks reaches more than 85%, and the quantization algorithm can accurately quantify the crack area and other information.

articleTitle: Construction of Government Big Data Management Index System Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: At present, big data management capability has gradually become an important auxiliary decision-making means for leading cadres. Using analytic hierarchy process and spss software to process data, the index system of big data management is constructed, which mainly includes data collection ability, data analysis ability and data application ability.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Multi Database Access Technology in ASP.NET
publicationTitle: CIBDA 2022; 3rd International Conference on Computer Information and Big Data Applications
abstract: Multi database access technology has become a developmental trend in web project, and has received more and more attention and research. This paper chooses ASP.Net framework as the core, combines online learning platform item in post COVID-19 epidemic period, explores the design and the implementation about multi database access in ASP.NET, proves the method has a certain social value.
